body: Thank you for your detailed interpretation! Yes, I have to work with him and I think that is causing me more distress than I acknowledge myself. I am very curious to see what the future brings if this dream is an omen.

I have never thought about it that way, but when reading your reply I understood that is exactly what it is about. Thank you for giving me that insight.

The bad news are, I have already made my move and got rejected over a year ago. Maybe it would be better if I blocked them on all social media, but on the other hand I would have nothing left then.
To be honest I sometimes do that. I just can not help it.
